purpose: Route the complete raw Impress command inventory into product-level families, track release-evidence maturity, and distinguish it from AI tool exposure. Raw UNO commands are evidence inputs, not an AI API.

engineBaseline.product: Collabora Online cp-26.04.4-1 source / stock CODE 26.04.3.2.1 runtime

states.runtime_verified: Typed operation, permission check, live readback, native Undo and browser-session probe all pass.
states.runtime_verified_auxiliary_tool: The same safety and browser-session gates pass, but the operation still travels through a specialized asset tool rather than the native edit schema.
states.engine_patch_ready: A bounded adapter and isolated source patch exist for the declared undo-v level. Promotion still requires the compiled native suite, browser Undo/save/reopen/playback evidence where applicable, and independent PowerPoint release validation.
states.format_excluded: The target format or the pinned engine cannot preserve the edited property, so AI mutation is intentionally unavailable.
states.observation_verified: The live browser editor exposes stable, bounded structure for this family and the observation was checked on a representative public PPTX; mutation safety is a separate state.
states.runtime_validation_required: A bounded typed adapter exists and its immediate browser transaction passes, but save/reopen, visual or native-application release gates remain.
states.typed_adapter_required: The human editor has the capability, but the AI still needs a bounded schema, readback and Undo test.
states.observation_required: Safe execution depends on first exposing the relevant structure and stable targets.
states.visual_validation_required: Deterministic structure checks are insufficient; render or media-specific review is required.
states.platform_owned: The product platform, not the model, owns this lifecycle operation.
states.human_ui_only: Useful editor state that should not be an AI document mutation.
states.security_excluded: Intentionally unavailable to document AI because it expands authority beyond the document contract.

rawUiCommandRouting.policy: Every observed Impress UI command is routed to a product semantic family. Routing proves inventory coverage only; it does not make a raw UNO command an AI tool or satisfy that family's runtime release gates.

aiToolExposure.runtimeGuard: The connector checks the live editor patch level and document permission before every operation.

semanticFamilies.scope: open, lock, save candidate, version, undo/redo, approve, download and recover
semanticFamilies.decision: Keep identity, locking, immutable original, version promotion and recovery outside model tools; expose status only.

semanticFamilies.scope: insert, duplicate, delete, reorder, hide, layout, rename and sections
next: promote the implemented section adapter only after native Undo, save/reopen and independent PowerPoint validation

semanticFamilies.scope: background fills, master assignment, master objects, theme and slide size
next: promote the implemented bounded slide-size and existing-master theme adapter after visual and PowerPoint validation
keep arbitrary new master/layout authoring outside the bounded beta contract

semanticFamilies.scope: position, size, rotation, flip, z-order, alignment, distribution, grouping, duplication and deletion
next: validate the implemented connector and freeform geometry paths against saved PPTX output
use the existing resize and alignment primitives for equal-size operations instead of adding a duplicate command

semanticFamilies.scope: fill, outline, opacity, dash, arrowheads, gradients, patterns, shadows and effects
next: gate gradient/effects on serialized and visual equivalence

semanticFamilies.scope: whole-object text, runs, paragraphs, fields and search/replace
next: expose run and paragraph identities
model dynamic fields explicitly

semanticFamilies.scope: font family/size/color, weight, posture, underline, strike, shadow, case, script and spacing
next: promote the implemented whole-object case and language adapters after save/reopen and PowerPoint validation
keep range-specific language and case mutation outside the contract until range-level readback is available

semanticFamilies.scope: alignment, vertical alignment, bullets, numbering, indentation, spacing, direction, columns, margins and autofit
next: promote the implemented paragraph identity and list mutation path after save/reopen and PowerPoint validation
detect overflow with engine metrics plus screenshot review

semanticFamilies.scope: create, cell text/style/borders, rows, columns, merge/split, dimensions and distribution
next: verify merged-cell content, formatting and exact outline geometry on representative tables
extend the verified bounded cell-format adapter to paragraph, margin and four-side border variants only after each property has exact readback
verify each border color and point width through BorderLine readback, Undo/Redo, save/reopen and PowerPoint instead of treating a visible border as completion

semanticFamilies.scope: insert/generated image, replace, crop, transparency, filters, video and audio
next: promote typed image and media insertion, identity-preserving replacement and playback settings after native history and save/reopen validation
preserve the imported picture-to-shape exclusion where a no-op Collabora save already flattens the source rectangle
keep remote asset fetching platform-mediated

semanticFamilies.scope: chart types, series, categories, data, labels, axes, legends and formatting
next: map embedded workbook and external-link identity separately from the verified chart type, series, category/series labels and data-matrix observation
promote the implemented chart-format adapter after identity-replacement, visual and PowerPoint validation
extend beyond the verified fixed-size internal-data values and labels to embedded workbooks and externally linked charts

semanticFamilies.scope: diagram data, layout, styles and fallback drawing shapes
next: promote the implemented semantic node set, add and delete adapters only on diagrams whose semantic model is observable
route imported fallback groups without semantic diagram data to an OOXML-aware preservation path
never flatten SmartArt merely to make it editable

semanticFamilies.scope: connectors and glue points, Bezier/freeform, 3D and Fontwork
next: promote the implemented connector, freeform, 3D material and Fontwork adapters after visual and PowerPoint validation
keep connector endpoint attachment bounded to observed top-level objects and glue points

semanticFamilies.scope: links, action settings, mouse-over/click behavior and QR objects
next: extend beyond the verified safe HTTP(S) click action only after each action type has saved-state and PowerPoint playback evidence
keep mouse-over, executable programs, macros, sounds and arbitrary files outside the AI contract until each gets an explicit product and security decision

semanticFamilies.scope: object animations, slide transitions, durations, order and rehearsal timing
next: promote the implemented effect insertion, removal, preset replacement and ordering adapters after native history, reopen and playback evidence
validate playback rather than static screenshots alone

semanticFamilies.scope: speaker notes, annotations, author threads, alt text, title/description and reading order
next: promote the implemented comment lifecycle, accessibility audit and complete top-level reading-order adapter after save/reopen and PowerPoint validation
continue to expose speaker notes separately from visible slide content

semanticFamilies.scope: math, OLE/package objects and linked files
next: promote the implemented bounded Math formula-source adapter after round-trip and PowerPoint evidence
do not execute or fetch embedded active content

semanticFamilies.scope: zoom, panes, ruler, guides, selection, slide show and presenter state
semanticFamilies.decision: AI may request observation or focus but must not pretend editor-view commands are document edits.

semanticFamilies.scope: macros, Basic, form controls, address books, scanners, external editing and arbitrary links
semanticFamilies.decision: Keep disabled in AI document sessions; preserve inert source content according to format policy.

semanticFamilies.scope: save as, export, PDF, print, email and remote-file commands
semanticFamilies.decision: Use server-authoritative candidate validation and download/export APIs, never raw editor file or network commands.

releaseRule: An operation or transaction mode moves into the public runtime contract only after typed schema, permission enforcement, revision binding, exact live readback, native Undo/Redo, failed-batch rollback and browser-session verification all pass. Visual families additionally require rendered review, and engine_patch_ready behavior requires a patched Collabora image probe.
